This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for October 3, 2026.

Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition.

1. Palestinians gather for football amid Gaza's ruins. Displaced Palestinians gathered to watch a friendly football match in Gaza's Khan Younis. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

2. Israeli settlers attack farmers in West Bank pogrom, soldiers hit reporters. Israeli forces detain and assault journalists in Jabal Qamass area in Beita, south of Nablus. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

3. Israeli air attack on residential apartment in Gaza kills 5 Palestinians. An Israeli air attack on a residential apartment in Gaza City has killed at least five Palestinians. This was reported by Al Jazeera.
